strings.module.plotter-nex.name: Plot 3D
strings.module.plotter-nex.description: G-code 3D path plotter: program toolpath with live run overlay.
strings.module.plotter-nex.vulkanUnavailableHint: No Vulkan 1.3 device could be created — 2D plotting stays available.
strings.module.plotter-nex.vulkanUnavailable.not: Vulkan 1.3 or newer is required, and the graphics device Vulkan selected does not report it. Run vulkaninfo --summary to see what your system reports. 2D plotting stays available.
strings.module.plotter-nex.vulkanUnavailable.run: Vulkan reported an error while preparing 3D plotting — the loader may be missing, or no device exposes the required queues. Run vulkaninfo --summary to check. 2D plotting stays available.
strings.module.plotter-nex.vulkanUnavailable.out: The Vulkan driver ran out of memory creating a 3D context. Close other applications using the GPU and try again. 2D plotting stays available.
strings.module.plotter-nex.vulkanUnavailable.oth: 3D plotting could not start or continue. See the diagnostics log for the exact error. 2D plotting stays available.
